The breaking change is requiring Node.js version v24 as the Actions runtime.

## What's Changed
* feat: Parse versions from metadata links by @ppkarwasz in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/632
* Upgrade actions core and actions github packages by @truggeri in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/649
* docs: Add notes for using `alert-lookup` with App Token by @sue445 in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/656
* feat!: update Node.js version to v24 by @sturman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/671
* Switch build tooling from ncc to esbuild by @truggeri in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/676
* Add --legal-comments=none to esbuild build commands by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/679
* Bump tsconfig target from es2022 to es2024 by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/680
* Remove vestigial outDir from tsconfig.json by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/681
* Switch tsconfig module resolution to bundler by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/682
* Remove skipLibCheck from tsconfig.json by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/683
* Add typecheck step to CI by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/685
* Enable noImplicitAny in tsconfig.json by @jeffwidman in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/684
* Upgrade @actions/core to ^3.0.0 by @truggeri in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/677
* Upgrade @actions/github to ^9.0.0 and @octokit/request-error to ^7.1.0 by @truggeri in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/678
* Bump qs from 6.14.0 to 6.14.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/651
* Bump hono from 4.11.1 to 4.11.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/652
* Bump hono from 4.11.4 to 4.11.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/653
* Bump hono from 4.11.7 to 4.12.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/657
* Bump qs from 6.14.1 to 6.14.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/655
* Bump @modelcontextprotocol/sdk from 1.25.1 to 1.26.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/654
* Bump @hono/node-server from 1.19.9 to 1.19.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/665
* Bump hono from 4.12.2 to 4.12.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/664
* Bump minimatch from 3.1.2 to 3.1.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/667
* Bump hono from 4.12.5 to 4.12.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/668
* Bump actions/create-github-app-token from 2.2.1 to 3.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/669
* Bump flatted from 3.3.3 to 3.4.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/670
* build(deps-dev): bump picomatch from 2.3.1 to 2.3.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dependabot/fetch-metadata/pull/674
